calculate_date_num_bins: calculate the number of date bins given a min, max, and interval with optional unknown bin
convert_date_to_bin: convert a date value to its corresponding bin index within a date range
convert_bin_to_date: convert a bin index back to a representative date value
generate_date_range_distribution: generate a uniform distribution over date bins from a date range with optional logit conversion
test_date_conversion_roundtrip: test roundtrip conversion between dates and bins using bin_to_date and date_to_bin
